name: How long does it take to install D-shaped cabinet handles?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install D-shaped cabinet handles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installation time for D-shaped cabinet handles depends on the number of handles and the complexity of the job. For a typical kitchen with 20-30 handles, a professional can often complete the installation in 3-6 hours, assuming pre-drilled holes or efficient use of a drilling template. If drilling all new holes by hand without a jig, it will take considerably longer. Larger projects or challenging cabinet materials may also extend the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 3-6 hours for 20-30 handles with a professional. Time varies based on the number of handles and whether new holes are drilled.
